description: This file defines an abstract base class 'QueueBalancerBase' for managing stream queue balancing in Orleans. It includes logic for handling cluster membership updates, managing listeners, and orchestrating cluster change notifications.

classes.name: QueueBalancerBase
classes.description: An abstract base class for stream queue balancers, handling cluster membership changes, listener subscriptions, and shutdown procedures.

methods.name: GetMyQueues
methods.description: Returns the queues associated with this balancer instance.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the queue balancer and starts listening for cluster changes.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Gracefully shuts down the queue balancer and stops listening for cluster updates.

methods.name: SubscribeToQueueDistributionChangeEvents
methods.description: Subscribes a listener to queue distribution change events.

methods.name: UnSubscribeFromQueueDistributionChangeEvents
methods.description: Unsubscribes a listener from queue distribution change events.

methods.name: NotifyListeners
methods.description: Notifies all subscribed listeners about queue distribution changes.

methods.name: ListenForClusterChanges
methods.description: Asynchronously listens for changes in cluster membership and triggers change handling.
